strategicRole: legacy commerce reference to reconcile into platform
evidenceRule: source-backed; documentation alone is not implementation proof

evidence.finding: Repository itself records TypeScript platform convergence intent; treated as plan, not proof.

capabilities.name: Commerce operating UI
capabilities.finding: Products, orders, inventory, finance, marketing, CRM, purchasing, and operations pages exist.

capabilities.name: Persistence
capabilities.finding: Per-user SQLite model exists, separate from platform tenancy.

capabilities.name: AI helpers
capabilities.finding: Anthropic-powered helpers exist but are BYOK/product-local.

capabilities.name: Events
capabilities.finding: A local events.py module exists; no durable event bus/outbox was found.

gaps: Python/Streamlit and per-user SQLite duplicate commerce, identity, finance, and CRM truth now present in platform.
Broad feature count does not establish production integration quality or data migration readiness.
Tenant, RBAC, audit, and approval controls differ from platform conventions.
Local AI helpers lack shared governance, citations, and evaluations.
